title.narrative: Integrated low carbon cooling and cold chain for agriculture products in Thailand

description.narrative: UNIDO received a request letter from the Thailand National Farmer Council to formulate a GEF9 project on sustainable cold chain. The proposed GEF-9 project, Integrated Low Carbon Cold Chain for Agriculture Products in Thailand, led by UNIDO in partnership with Thailand#s National Farmers Council (NFC), aims to transform Thailand#s agri-food system by reducing greenhouse gas emissions, minimising post-harvest losses, and restoring degraded agricultural landscapes through an integrated low-carbon cold chain approach. The project will deploy ten community-based cold chain hubs powered by solar energy and low-GWP refrigerants, establish agro-industrial processing centres, strengthen sustainable land management practices across 20,000 hectares, and introduce a national digital traceability and monitoring platform linked to Thailand#s climate and agricultural systems. Targeting 3,000 smallholder farmers # particularly women and youth # the project applies a Public#Private#Community Partnership (PPCP) model to improve market access, increase farmer incomes, and catalyse private investment in climate-smart agriculture.
